answer.answer: MGNREGA provides at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled work [E01]. The other programme from the Ministry of Rural Development that supplies pucca houses to rural households is Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G), which aims at providing a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas [E02].

claim_to_evidence.claim: MGNREGA provides at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled work

Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) is a programme from the Ministry of Rural Development that aims at providing a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas
